name: Nanase Rika
source:
The second eldest Nanase daughter. Top grades and in the class council, she's a force to be reckoned with. As such, she's always on her [url=/c64510]older brother's[/url] case for being lazy. She's naturally strict with everyone, but we all know that deep down she loves her brother.

"Grrr, Nii-san! Stop with all that pervy stuff!!"

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1162]MangaGamer[/url]]
